title: ANC Identifier Types Schema
description: JSON Schema for ANC Identifier Types ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions using IRI format.
narrative: This schema validates IRI-formatted codes for the ANC Identifier Types ValueSet. Each enum value includes the system URI in the format {systemuri}#{code} to match JSON-LD enumeration IRIs. Display values are available at http://fhir.org/guides/who/core/ValueSet-who-identifier-types.displays.json. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
